verdict.rationale: Alma's own pages call it an immigration law firm and say every case is led by a dedicated attorney, with clients meeting a case attorney. That is a first-party attorney-led model, not an unsupervised form service. However, the pages never name any lawyers, never state bar licensure, and never say an attorney prepares, signs or files the petition as attorney of record, so the story is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: named attorneys or bar-licensure details, an explicit attorney-of-record or signing/filing statement, independent corroboration of attorney involvement.

support.subject: As a founder, my petition is prepared and filed by licensed immigration attorneys — named lawyers or a stated attorney-of-record model on the provider's own pages, not an unsupervised form service
